summary: The IETF normally meets in person three times a year, but events can make a planned meeting infeasible. This Best Current Practice gives criteria to help the IETF LLC, the IESG and the IRTF Chair decide whether to relocate, virtualize, postpone or cancel an in-person meeting.

eli5.summary: Sometimes a big meeting can't happen where planned. This document helps leaders decide whether to move it, go online, delay it or call it off.

questions: when does ietf cancel a meeting
